disclaimer: For demonstration only. Fictional data; no live payments, investments, custody, identity checks or digital assets. Not investment, legal or Shariah advice.

videos.title: Introducing Mizant
videos.subtitle: Real assets. Clear rights. Ethical access.

beats.heading: Real assets can be difficult to access
beats.body: High minimums, complex structures and unclear ownership can make opportunities difficult to understand.

beats.heading: Mizant connects the full journey
beats.body: SMEs, originators, investors and independent reviewers work through one structured opportunity lifecycle.

beats.heading: Evidence begins with the asset
beats.body: The business need, productive asset and supporting documents are prepared as a controlled submission.

beats.heading: Independent review stays visible
beats.body: Legal, risk, compliance and Shariah decisions remain separate, attributable and connected to the reviewed version.

beats.heading: Investors see rights and risks
beats.body: Opportunity pages explain the asset, parties, cash-flow source, key risks and evidence status before any next step.

beats.heading: Tokenisation follows approval
beats.body: Digital units are prepared only after human gates, fixed-supply checks and maker-checker approval.

beats.heading: Ownership remains reconcilable
beats.body: Digital records connect to the controlled ownership register and a complete audit trail.

videos.closing_title: Real assets. Clear rights. Ethical access.
videos.closing_subtitle: Explore Mizant through the workspace that matches your role.

videos.title: Mizant platform walkthrough
videos.subtitle: A clear investor journey from access to an attributable demonstration record

beats.heading: Choose the Investor workspace
beats.body: Start with the role that matches your task. The platform explains the journey before you request access.

beats.heading: Use the demonstration profile
beats.body: Request fictional preview access, then open the workspace. No live identity provider is connected.

beats.heading: Begin with the next action
beats.body: The dashboard prioritises one useful next step and keeps role-specific navigation easy to find.

beats.heading: Find an available opportunity
beats.body: Status labels distinguish the reviewable reference case from opportunities that are still in diligence.

beats.heading: Understand the asset and structure
beats.body: Review the equipment, project vehicle, SME relationship and the rights represented by each digital unit.

beats.heading: Read the risks before scenarios
beats.body: Operating, asset, liquidity and structural risks appear before illustrative cash-flow outcomes.

beats.heading: Check the evidence status
beats.body: Each document is marked recorded, draft or conditional so incomplete evidence stays visible.

beats.heading: Complete the comprehension step
beats.body: Choose an illustrative amount and confirm the rights, liquidity limits and cash-flow dependency.

beats.heading: Create an attributable record
beats.body: The demonstration receipt connects the amount, disclosure version and environment without moving money.

beats.heading: Return to guidance at any time
beats.body: The Learning Centre provides short role guides, plain-language definitions and observable next actions.

videos.closing_title: Understand first. Act with a clear record.
videos.closing_subtitle: Open the Investor workspace to complete the demonstration journey.

videos.title: Choosing your Mizant workspace
videos.subtitle: Select the perspective that matches your task

beats.heading: Choose Investor
beats.body: Explore opportunities, review evidence and follow a controlled demonstration commitment.

beats.heading: Choose SME
beats.body: Describe a productive asset need, provide evidence and follow the human-review status.

beats.heading: Choose Originator
beats.body: Support an SME, resolve evidence gaps and hand a review-ready case to independent teams.

beats.heading: Your guidance follows your role
beats.body: Navigation and next actions adapt to the selected workspace while permissions remain controlled.

videos.title: Creating your demonstration profile
videos.subtitle: Enter the safe preview without using personal information

beats.heading: Keep the fictional details
beats.body: The supplied profile is demonstration data. Never enter real personal or confidential information.

beats.heading: Confirm the workspace
beats.body: Check that Investor, SME or Originator matches the journey you want to explore.

beats.heading: Request preview access
beats.body: The request creates a demonstration approval record rather than contacting a live identity service.

beats.heading: Open your workspace
beats.body: Continue to the role dashboard and follow the highlighted next action.

videos.title: Finding your way around the dashboard
videos.subtitle: Next action, navigation and role context

beats.heading: Start with the next action
beats.body: The dashboard brings the most useful task to the top of the page.

beats.heading: Use role-specific navigation
beats.body: Each workspace shows the tools and records relevant to that participant.

beats.heading: Switch perspective safely
beats.body: The workspace selector demonstrates another role without silently expanding permissions.

beats.heading: Choose Learn whenever needed
beats.body: Short procedures explain the responsible person, required actions and expected result.

videos.title: Finding and reviewing an opportunity
videos.subtitle: Check status and evidence before acting

beats.heading: Check the opportunity status
beats.body: Only the reference case is available for review; incomplete pipeline cases remain unavailable.

beats.heading: Read the headline terms
beats.body: Asset pool, proposed term and unit reference are clearly marked as illustrative.

beats.heading: Open the detailed review
beats.body: The full page brings the asset, parties, rights, risks and documents into one journey.

beats.heading: Understand what each unit means
beats.body: Digital units represent approved rights within the structure; they are not the physical asset itself.

videos.title: Reviewing documents and key information
videos.subtitle: Asset, structure, risks and evidence status

beats.heading: Start with the information basis
beats.body: Check the information date and whether each statement is recorded, illustrative or conditional.

beats.heading: Follow the parties and rights
beats.body: See who owns, uses, reviews and administers the asset and related records.

beats.heading: Review what could go wrong
beats.body: Read operating, asset, liquidity and structural risks before considering any scenario.

beats.heading: Inspect the document status
beats.body: Recorded, draft and conditional labels reveal what is complete and what still requires approval.

beats.heading: Continue only after review
beats.body: Open the commitment step after understanding the asset, rights, risks and evidence status.

beats.heading: Choose an illustrative amount
beats.body: The amount is used only to demonstrate the workflow; no payment or investment is created.

beats.heading: Confirm comprehension
beats.body: Acknowledge the rights, liquidity limits and dependence on rent actually received.

beats.heading: Review the resulting record
beats.body: The receipt links the amount, disclosure version and audit reference in the demonstration environment.

videos.title: Submitting an opportunity for human review
videos.subtitle: Three guided steps with independent review

beats.heading: Describe the fictional business
beats.body: Start with the operating need, business context and responsible demonstration contact.

beats.heading: Define the productive asset
beats.body: Explain the equipment, intended use and why the business needs it.

beats.heading: Complete the evidence checklist
beats.body: Confirm each fictional evidence placeholder and the safe-submission declaration.

beats.heading: Submit for independent review
beats.body: Legal, compliance and Shariah reviewers receive separate tasks. Submission is not approval.

videos.title: Getting guidance and reading status indicators
videos.subtitle: Clear procedures and observable next actions

beats.heading: Choose a role guide
beats.body: Each guide explains the actions, responsible person and result you should expect.

beats.heading: Read the status first
beats.body: Status chips show what has happened, what is waiting and which action comes next.

beats.heading: Follow the audit reference
beats.body: Decisions remain attributable and connected to the relevant record version.

beats.heading: Keep human approval visible
beats.body: Review queues make clear who is responsible and prevent one participant from self-approving.
